About Organization

Central Bank of India is a nationalized bank in India. It was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Mumbai.

As per official notification, the bank has released the notification for the recruitment of apprentices for the year 2026-27.

About the Programme

The CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment program announced by the Central Bank of India. The program aims to recruit apprentices for the year 2026-27.

The program is open to candidates who have a graduation degree from any recognized university in India.
